current_behavior.primary_error: preserves and rethrows the first compute error; it does not continue
current_behavior.wave_failure: aborts remaining factors and closes the input iterator

reusable_components: batch_service physical_preflight_errors for the narrow production DataAccess case
minimum_design: return structured per-root errors from scheduler/batch service
continue independent roots; block only roots depending on a failed shared CSE
abort on sink, cancellation, broker authority, or scope-wide source failures
converge every requested ordinal to SUCCEEDED, FAILED, BLOCKED, or CANCELLED
retain cse_scope=per_wave until a scope/snapshot/window-bound stream ExecutionSession exists
unsafe_shortcut: Do not bisect or rerun an aborted wave outside the runner because already submitted sink results may be duplicated.
